title: Interactions of neocryptotanshinone and human cytochrome P450 in silico and in vitro.
authors: Chen, Xiu; Pan, Xiaoyi; Zhao, Jieping; Jin, Huihui; Zhang, Hengbin; Song, Yongbiao; Zhou, Hui; Yao, Jianbiao; Jiang, Huidi
journal: Toxicology in vitro : an international journal published in association with BIBRA
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新隐丹参酮与细胞色素P450酶的相互作用，涉及分子对接但对象为药物-代谢酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neocryptotanshinone (NCTS), an ingredient of Salviae Miltiorrhizae Radix et Rhizoma, is a promising compound for development since it exhibits various pharmacological effects including hypoglycemic and anti-inflammatory activities. In this study, we aimed to elucidate the interactions between NCTS and cytochrome P450s (CYPs), including the CYP-mediated NCTS metabolism and NCTS-induced CYP regulation. The results revealed that NCTS was mainly metabolized by CYPs in human liver microsomes (HLMs), and CYP2C8 and 2C9 were identified as the main CYPs involved; the relative contributions of CYP2C8 and 2C9 were 35 % and 65 %, respectively, after normalization of individual CYP abundance in the human liver. Meanwhile, NCTS weakly inhibited CYP1A2, 2C8, and 2C9, with IC(50) > 30 muM. In addition, NCTS induced CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 expression in human primary hepatocytes, and the underlying mechanism was found by the activation of the pregnane X receptor (PXR) vis reporter gene assay. Molecular docking of NCTS and CYPs, PXR confirmed these results. Our study sheds light on the interactions of NCTS with CYPs and provides useful information for predicting potential drug-drug interactions for NCTS, which will be helpful for NCTS development and clinical utilization of drugs containing NCTS.
abstract_zh: 新隐丹参酮（NCTS）是丹参（Salviae Miltiorrhizae Radix et Rhizoma）的一种成分，因其具有多种药理作用，包括降血糖和抗炎活性，是一种有开发前景的化合物。本研究旨在阐明NCTS与细胞色素P450酶（CYPs）之间的相互作用，包括CYP介导的NCTS代谢及NCTS诱导的CYP调控。结果表明，NCTS在人肝微粒体（HLMs）中主要由CYPs代谢，其中CYP2C8和2C9被鉴定为主要参与的CYP；在归一化人肝脏中个体CYP丰度后，CYP2C8和C2C9的相对贡献分别为35%和65%。同时，NCTS对CYP1A2、2C8和2C9具有弱抑制作用，IC(50) > 30 μM。此外，NCTS在人原代肝细胞中诱导CYP2B6和CYP3A4表达，并通过报告基因实验发现其潜在机制涉及孕烷X受体（PXR）的激活。NCTS与CYPs、PXR的分子对接结果证实了这些发现。本研究揭示了NCTS与CYPs的相互作用，为预测NCTS潜在的药物-药物相互作用提供了有用信息，这将有助于NCTS的开发及含NCTS药物的临床应用。
